chapter: Return to New Orleans and Sharkey
title: Starting at the Famous Door; Marathon and Dreamland
summary: He has been at the Famous Door twenty-five years since 1948, with a marathon dance at the St. Charles Theater and Dreamland before.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: How long have you been at, you must have been at the famous store for a very long time now
then. Twenty-five years altogether. Yeah. See, I started there with Sharky, 48. Yeah. Then I left town for about a year. I'd have been there a long, long time. But, what do you want to be around?
You want to put some water in. It wasn't always your own band and you played with other bands there too.

No, the only band I would play there was with Sharky. Oh, then you took the other band. My Sharky band was my band. You see, we played the Speed Derby, you know what the Speed Derby is? You know, they walk around for a day, for weeks and all that stuff. You know.

Marathon, yeah. On that St. Charles Theater, see. So then when that finished, I went to the Dream Room, at Dream Land. You don't remember Dream Land. Never was there. You know where Swaygman is around there? That big dance hall that you used to have? At Elysian Fields? No, right by Swaygman on the Airline Highway.
Oh yeah, I know where that is.

So I brought Sharky there with me, because Sharky was playing with me at the Marathon, see. And then we went to the Dream Land, and from there, when I got finished there, I went to the Preview. Remember the Preview? On Ken Allen and Wright. Yeah. Yeah, right by the...
Meal and Minutes. Meal and Minutes. Yeah.
